description: This is a PHP abstract class 'BaseLoader' within the 'PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Ods' namespace. It defines a base structure for loading ODS spreadsheet data, with properties for a Spreadsheet object and a namespace string, and an abstract method 'read' for subclasses to implement.

classes.name: BaseLoader
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for ODS spreadsheet loaders, holding references to a Spreadsheet object and a namespace string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the spreadsheet and namespace properties.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to read workbook data from a DOMElement.
